sections.title: Black Style: Fashions, Fictions, and Films of the 1920s
sections.description: This course will explore literature, art, film, and politics of the 1920s Harlem Renaissance, also known as the New Negro Movement. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
